name: Witch's Homework
title: Witch's Homework
desc: "Rather than a scenario where we jump in and save the day out of nowhere, it makes more sense to lay the groundwork over time..."

skills.desc: Draw 1 Talent card. If your deck initially contains at least 3 Talent cards, grant Cost Reduction to a random Talent card with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost in your Hand.
